sentence_stem: Although many people prefer to drive,
correct_completion: public transport is cheaper and better for the environment.
full_sentence: Although many people prefer to drive, public transport is cheaper and better for the environment.
acceptable_variants: the environment benefits when fewer cars are used.
cities would become quieter and less polluted.

options.text: so they should never use cars at all.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, but 'although' sets up a contrast, so this option does not fit the connector.

options.text: they both need a lot of fuel every day.
options.why_wrong: This adds a fact about cars but does not contrast with the first clause, which 'although' requires.

options.text: public transport is cheaper and better for the environment.
it is raining outside at the moment.
options.why_wrong: This is an unrelated fact about the weather and does not develop the argument about travel choices.

explanation: After 'although', the second clause must contrast with the first. Turkish speakers may expect a result or cause pattern here, so check that the main clause opposes the idea in the stem.
